surprises_or_findings: Idempotency-key shape divergence (AC #5 surface point): the existing coherence-escalation rule uses (rule-name, epicId, stage) — three components, no anomalyType. wlsr.14's stuck-in-stage chose (rule-name, epicId, stage, anomalyType, windowStart) — five components with windowStart as the per-stall-window discriminator. This bead's missed-wave-review-dispatch uses (rule-name, epicId, stage, anomalyType, correlationId) — also five components, with correlationId as the per-exit discriminator. Two reasons for the divergence from coherence-escalation: (a) AC #1 forbids changing existing skip conditions, including the per-correlationId scoping that lets a single epic recover from multiple distinct missed exits in one idempotency horizon; (b) ADR-015 § Consequences names anomalyType as a cross-rule de-dup discriminator (refinement of ADR-009). For missed-wave-review-dispatch's purposes the stage and anomalyType are constants ('build-review' / 'missed-wave-review-dispatch'), so they add no behavioural change today, but they future-proof the key against new rules that might detect different anomalyTypes on the same (epicId, stage). Cross-rule de-dup with coherence-escalation continues to work because the rule-name prefix differs (`missed-wave-review-dispatch::...` vs `coherence-escalation::...`); the reconciler core's dedup is per (rule-name, key) so both rules can fire independently. Pattern matches wlsr.14's resolution exactly. — EventSummary import path: imported as `type EventSummary` from '../coherence-journal' per wlsr.2's marker decision (EventSummary = PipelineEvent re-export). No redefinition. — waveCompletionEvidence field source (RISK FLAGS surface point): there is no `waveCompletionEvidence` field on EpicSnapshot or any ReconcilerSnapshot type. Derived at act-time from snapshot.waveStatus.{hasWaves,currentWave,allWavesComplete} + snapshot.openBugCount + the original exit metadata (originalExitAt, originalCorrelationId from match.context). The substitute is a structured object that surfaces the inputs pre-cutover branching consumed (pre-cutover decided start-wave-or-smoke-test from these fields; post-cutover hands them to coherence as evidence). — marker omission per ADR-015 § 3: missed-wave-review-dispatch is event-log-triggered (build-review agent-exited event), not marker-triggered, so EscalationContext.marker is left undefined — coherence will read events.jsonl directly during diagnosis, marker is not the triggering signal here. Mirrors stuck-in-stage's wlsr.14 pattern. — Pre-cutover act()-throws-on-snapshot-error contract preserved: the rule throws when snapshot.waveStatus.error is set (bd failure), letting the reconciler's always-emit-action-taken safety (zsjv hotfix 2026-04-21) consume the idempotency bucket with an error payload rather than dispatching a partial EscalationContext. Tested by regression test 'snapshot.waveStatus.error throws — action-taken emitted with error payload'. — Reconciler-bootstrap.ts wiring not modified: missed-wave-review-dispatch is already registered in bootstrap (line 261-278) with the readEpicSnapshot wired to readEpicState; the rule's signature didn't change so no bootstrap update needed. Contrast with wlsr.7 which had to add new options (readMarker, repoPath) and required bootstrap changes.
